description: A specialized AppDimens module designed for Android game development with C++/NDK support. Provides responsive dimensioning, game-specific utilities, and native performance optimizations for game engines like Cocos2d-x, OpenGL ES, and Vulkan. Includes game UI scaling, viewport management, and cross-platform dimension consistency. (android, kotlin, java, c++, ndk, games, opengl, vulkan, cocos2d-x, responsive, dimensions, game-development, native-performance)
